[FACT] User recently landed a role as one of the nuns in the chorus for a local community theater production of "The Sound of Music."  
[PREFERENCE] User wants to make sure they are ready for the musical numbers.  
[EVENT] User is looking for tips on how to prepare for a singing audition.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on landing the role and provided tips for preparing for the singing audition.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant created a list of 10 tips for preparing for the singing audition, including:  
1. Familiarize yourself with the score.  
2. Practice, practice, practice.  
3. Work on your vocal technique.  
4. Learn the harmonies.  
5. Rehearse with movement.  
6. Focus on diction and articulation.  
7. Get comfortable with your vocal range.  
8. Learn the choreography.  
9. Attend rehearsals prepared.  
10. Take care of your voice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided additional tips for preparation, including understanding the story and character, practicing with accompaniment, and visualizing successful performance.
